title: Linearity and naturality of completed pullback, direct image, and exchange
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, and put $A=\mathcal O_E$, $I=(\varpi)$ and $P_n=A/\varpi^n$ for a uniformizer $\varpi$ and $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$, use the completed coefficient sheaf $A_W=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_W$ and $D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_W))$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $\mathcal C_W$ be its full subcategory of derived $I$-complete objects [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], with the $A$-linear structure [def-weil-linear-category] induced by constant sections of $A_W$.

For every morphism of schemes $u:U\to V$, the canonical map $u^{-1}A_V\to A_U$ is the isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image]. Derived module direct image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] along $u^{-1}A_V\to A_U$ restricts to a functor $D_u=Ru_*:\mathcal C_U\to\mathcal C_V$. Completed pullback [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] is a functor $P_u=Lu^*_{\mathrm{comp}}:\mathcal C_V\to\mathcal C_U$. Both functors are additive and $A$-linear [def-weil-linear-functor], and $P_u\dashv D_u$. For a second morphism $v:Z\to U$, the canonical composition isomorphism $P_vP_u\cong P_{u\circ v}$ is natural.

For any cartesian square of schemes $f:X\to S$, $g:T\to S$, $h:Y\to X$, $e:Y\to T$ with $f h=g e$ [sbc-def-base-change-square], these composition comparisons give $\theta:P_hP_f\xrightarrow{\sim}P_eP_g$. Write $\eta_h$ for the unit of $P_h\dashv D_h$ and $\varepsilon_g$ for the counit of $P_g\dashv D_g$. The canonical integral completed exchange is the natural transformation with components
$$
 \alpha_K=D_h(P_e(\varepsilon_{g,K}))\circ D_h(\theta_{D_gK})\circ\eta_{h,P_fD_gK}:
 P_fD_gK\longrightarrow D_hP_eK\qquad(K\in\mathcal C_T).
$$
In particular, for every $a:K\to K'$ in $\mathcal C_T$,
$$D_hP_e(a)\circ\alpha_K=\alpha_{K'}\circ P_fD_g(a).$$
Under the canonical finite-reduction comparisons [lemma-weil-pbc-completed-pullback-reduction, prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits] and direct-image/derived-limit comparisons [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits], this specified mate is the completed exchange obtained from the finite-level exchange transformations. This assertion imposes no smoothness, properness or constructibility hypothesis and asserts no invertibility of $\alpha_K$.

source.place: Tag 099N, lemma-pushforward-Noetherian-case, clauses (1)-(5); linear and natural-mate refinement for the completed coefficient sheaves, using the comparison of lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence. The linear-functor convention is Tag 09MK, dga.tex, definition-functor-linear-categories. The ringed-topos completed adjunction is also Tag 099K, algebraization.tex, lemma-pushforward-derived-complete-adjoint; its ideal hypothesis holds because the coefficient map sends the constant section varpi to varpi.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr] and [lem-weil-valued-dvr-finite-quotients], $A$ is Noetherian and $P_n$ is finite torsion and perfect, using $[A\xrightarrow{\varpi^n}A]$. The coefficient isomorphisms preserve projections and composites [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image]. Products are exact [lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact]. Apply [lem-sbc-koszul-fibre-linear-descent] to the intrinsic model; complete objects are additive and completion is linear. Ordinary operations are linear by [lem-sbc-ambient-operations-scalar-linearity].

Direct image preserves completeness [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. Completed pullback is ordinary pullback followed by Koszul completion, with its completion unit [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. The Koszul reflector [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector], identified with intrinsic completion by [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence], and ordinary adjunction [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] satisfy [lem-sbc-reflector-adjunction-unit-formulas]. Thus $P_u=C_UL_u\dashv D_u$ is linear, with its specified unit and counit.

Use direct-image composition [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] and ordinary pullback composition [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. Derived conjugacy is [lem-sfb-derived-composition-adjunction-normalization]. Their conjugates give $P_vP_u\cong P_{uv}$; [lem-sbc-reflected-compositor-unit-normalization] identifies their completion-unit normalization. The two paths of the square therefore give the normalized $\theta$.

The mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] is the displayed $\alpha$. Naturality of its three factors proves the stated equation. By [lem-sbc-reflector-square-mate-factorization] it is uniquely characterized by $\alpha_K\kappa_{L_fR_gK}=R_h(\kappa_{L_eK})b_K$, where $b$ is the ambient mate.

Every edge $u$ has invertible coefficient map [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image], so [lem-sbc-unbounded-exact-adjunction-square] applies on the small diagram sites [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization]: constants and evaluations identify the ordinary derived units, counits and square mates with the termwise ones.

$A_W$ is flat with $A_W/\varpi^n=(P_n)_W$ [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence], so $[A_W\xrightarrow{\varpi^n}A_W]$ makes $Q_{W,n}=(P_n)_W$ perfect. Apply [lem-sbc-strict-quotient-exchange-unit-equation] with step 5: $\gamma=c^{-1}R\lim(v)s$ has finite evaluations the $P_n$ mates and $\gamma\,\mathrm{comp}_M=R_h(\mathrm{comp}_E)b$. By [prop-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction], $\mathrm{comp}=\rho\kappa$ with $\rho$ the natural Koszul/quotient isomorphism, so $\tilde\gamma=R_h(\rho_E^{-1})\gamma\rho_M$ satisfies the equation of step 4; its source and target are $P_fD_gK$, $D_hP_eK$ with the specified identifications [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. Reflector uniqueness gives $\alpha=\tilde\gamma$, without faithfulness of evaluations.
